page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highcpu-2 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the c4n family. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs and 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage.

Designed with a compute-focused allocation, the dedicated vCPUs ensure consistent processing performance without the resource contention typical of shared-core or burstable instances. The low memory-to-vCPU ratio makes this instance a cost-efficient choice for workloads that demand dedicated processing power but have minimal memory footprints, optimizing resource utilization without paying for idle RAM.

The c4n-highcpu-2 instance is suited for lightweight compute-intensive tasks, microservices, batch processing, and simple web serving workloads that do not require local SSD storage or high memory capacity.
